title: Fermigier--Mestre canonical family and E22 model reproduction
scope: The fixed-root product construction with roots 0,55,314,378,1007,1036 is replayed exactly: the square remainder is quartic and twelve immediately visible affine points are checked. Binary-quartic invariants give a canonical Weierstrass family in the adapter coordinate u=s/2 with one primitive even degree-twenty discriminant factor; the apparent u^12 and 202464^12 raw factors are nonminimal coordinate artifacts. At u=19754/39 the canonical model and the doubled literal shift s=39508/39 minimize to Fermigier's displayed E22 equation and exact conductor. However the paper prints q=p6(x-t)p6(x+t) and t=19754/39; that literal shift gives a different j-invariant, model, and conductor. The factor-two discrepancy remains unresolved. Point reconstruction and rank lower bounds are separated into EC-FRANK1.
dependencies: external: PARI/GP 2.15.4 ellfromeqn, minimal-model, and conductor routines
